about: The hooks and tables in events.json that no module, draft, module adapter, base build or test subscribes, raises or contributes to yet, each with one line saying why (hook_coverage.py, run by sdk/tests/test_hook_coverage.py). A hook here is base code no module exercises: the first place to look when the base needs room. Remove a line in the pull request that gives its hook a user; the check fails on a line whose hook is used or gone.
